# Threat Intelligence

Primary sources:
- STIX/TAXII: OASIS CTI standards
- MISP: https://www.misp-project.org/
- OpenCTI: https://docs.opencti.io/
- vendor research: Splunk, Microsoft, CrowdStrike, Unit 42, Talos, Zscaler ThreatLabz, FortiGuard, Trellix ARC, Netskope Threat Labs.

Keep:
indicator,
observable,
actor/campaign,
technique,
source,
confidence,
time validity,
relationship,
TLP/sharing restrictions

as distinct concepts.
